description: Show every stored value for one field of a saved property, with its provider and date, plus which other providers could supply it and how many data credits a lookup uses. Free. Use this to answer "where did this number come from?" or before switching provider.

data_point.description: Data point key, e.g. physical.bedrooms or financial.estimated_equity. Call spur_list_data_providers to see keys.

name: spur_get_field_sources
title: Get sources for one field
